title: Overview of Deep Learning Research
content: Deep learning, as a strong trend in the fields of machine learning and artificial intelligence, is not only a hot topic in current academic research, but also a key force driving technological progress. As one of the latest trends in artificial intelligence research, deep learning has become one of the most eye-catching scientific research trends today due to its powerful data processing capabilities and pattern recognition accuracy. This paper summarizes the deep learning model and summarizes the application of deep learning in many fields.
